CommunityApplications.Profile:
Unraid Community Applications templates for the apps I maintain.
Each one is a small, single-container, self-hosted tool that does one job and keeps its data in one appdata folder. The images are built by GitHub Actions for both amd64 and arm64, and every template here points at the image built from a tagged release, never at an untested build.
Report a problem against the app's own issue tracker, linked from its Support field. I read them.
